verdict.rationale: Fathom documents API key generation in User Settings and an OAuth path for public apps, but nothing shows scopes, read-only limits, or other least-privilege restrictions on a credential. Keys inherit the generating user's access; an Admin's key can read everything shared across teams. That access-inheritance model is an adjacent permissions control, not scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
